messages:
laura_fin: flagging a discrepancy on Nimbus invoice INV-2028-0213. AR shows $33,200 but reconciliation says $36,000. there's a +$2,800 'burst reconciliation' line that wasn't expected.
ton y_ops: do we have burst logs for Nimbus for that window?
laura_fin: system matched usage = 36000, invoice total 33200, adjustment labeled BURST_RECONCILE +2800. no manual approvals on file.
billing-bot: auto-detect: invoice INV-2028-0213 -> commit C-NIM-2028Q1. detected ADJ=BURST_RECONCILE amount=+2800 origin=postprocess.
irene_sales: Nimbus did spike traffic on 2028-03-02 but they were on reserved capacity; sales didn't approve overage billing.
tony_ops: digging into postprocess job. quick log:
```
2028-03-18T09:02:10Z POSTPROC INFO invoice=INV-2028-0213 matched_usage=36000 applied_adjustments=[{"code":"BURST_RECONCILE","amount":2800}]
```
laura_fin: why was a positive adjustment (charge) applied without a notice? Finance put invoice on hold.
carl_cfo: if ops auto-applied reconciliation charges we need an audit trail and customer notification before unhold. pre-approve temporary hold.
tony_ops: root cause: postprocess job reconciles metered burst usage against commit and will auto-apply shortfall charge for customers with 'auto-bill' enabled. Nimbus has auto-bill ON but Sales reports they opted out months ago. Bug: sales opt-out flag not propagated to billing sandbox. opening ticket BG-9520.
laura_fin: plan: 1) reverse the +$2,800 charge and reissue invoice; 2) fix flag propagation; 3) notify customer with apology.
irene_sales: Nimbus prefers reversal + apology. they'll accept corrected invoice.
carl_cfo: approve reversal and patch. cap one-time goodwill to $1,000 if Nimbus pushes back. finance to record memo FIN-5860.
billing-bot: regen queued after BG-9520 fix. ETA regen 2028-03-19T05:00:00Z.
laura_fin: noted. will update once reversal processed.
